metadata.title: OKN Token | Earn, Claim, Buy on BNB Smart Chain
metadata.description: OKN is a community token on BNB Smart Chain. Earn via tasks, claim on-chain with Merkle proofs, or buy directly with BNB at a fixed rate.
metadata.ogImageAlt: OKN Token — earn, claim, buy on BNB Smart Chain

hero.paragraph: $OKN is the native utility and community token of the OKNEXUS Exchange ecosystem, built on BNB Smart Chain to deliver speed, security, and real-world utility. Every interaction creates value. Complete tasks, earn reward points, purchase with BNB, and claim your tokens directly on-chain through our Telegram App. More than a token, $OKN is your key to exclusive rewards, platform benefits, governance opportunities, and the future of decentralized finance. Join the movement. Own the future.

howToClaimPage.title: How to claim
howToClaimPage.metaDescription: Two ways to get $OKN: earn via tasks and claim on-chain, or buy directly with BNB. {fee} claim fee in BNB.
howToClaimPage.ogDescription: Earn $OKN via tasks or buy directly with BNB. Step-by-step guide.
howToClaimPage.heading: Two paths to your first $OKN
howToClaimPage.subheading: Earn it by participating in the community, or buy it directly. Both land $OKN in your wallet on BNB Smart Chain.
howToClaimPage.pathABody: Free to participate. Points convert to $OKN when an admin commits a Merkle root.
howToClaimPage.pathBBody: Instant on-chain purchase at a fixed rate. Per-wallet cap applies.

earnSteps.title: Open $OKN in Telegram
earnSteps.body: Tap "Open in Telegram" to launch the mini app. Your account is created from your Telegram identity — no separate sign-up.

earnSteps.title: Connect a BNB Smart Chain wallet
earnSteps.body: Inside the dashboard, connect MetaMask, Trust Wallet, or any EVM wallet. The address is bound to your Telegram account.

earnSteps.title: Complete tasks to earn points
earnSteps.body: Follow channels, join the group, refer friends. Each task awards points. Points are tracked off-chain until an admin commits a Merkle root.

earnSteps.title: Claim on-chain
earnSteps.body: Once your points are committed, the Claim page generates your Merkle proof and your wallet calls the distributor contract. A $3 BNB fee applies.

buySteps.title: Open the Buy page
buySteps.body: From the dashboard, open the Buy tab. You will see the current rate ($OKN per BNB), your remaining wallet cap, and sale status.

buySteps.title: Enter the BNB amount
buySteps.body: Type how much BNB you want to spend. The page previews the $OKN you will receive and validates against the per-wallet cap and minimum purchase.

buySteps.title: Confirm the purchase
buySteps.body: Your wallet calls TokenSale.buy() with the BNB attached. The contract mints $OKN directly to your address at the fixed rate.

buySteps.title: Track your purchase
buySteps.body: Every buy is recorded on-chain (Bought event) and indexed into the dashboard. Withdrawals of raised BNB are admin-gated and audit-logged.

faqs.question: When can I transfer $OKN?
faqs.answer: Immediately. There is no transfer lock on OKN tokens. Once claimed or purchased, you can send or swap them right away.

faqs.question: What is the claim fee?
faqs.answer: {fee} in BNB per claim, priced live via a Chainlink oracle. The fee funds the ecosystem treasury.

faqs.question: Do I need a wallet?
faqs.answer: Yes — any EVM wallet on BNB Smart Chain. Connect it inside the dashboard to bind it to your Telegram account.
